name: Crores — India's Biggest Everyday Number
whatIsIt: The Number Palace has one more wing! After lakh comes CRORE — India's word for ten million. A number like 3,25,00,000 has 3 crore and 25 lakh. Same comma pattern as before: three digits first, then two-two-two, all the way up.
whyNeeded: City populations, movie box-office numbers, national budgets and big company revenues are all reported in crores. Reading and comparing crore-scale numbers confidently means big Indian news numbers never feel confusing.
realLifeUses: A big city's population often crosses 1 crore (10,000,000) — Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru.
Bollywood box-office collections are reported in crores — the famous '100 crore club'.
A state or national budget is announced in thousands of crores of rupees.
A popular app or song can cross 10 crore (100 million) downloads or views.

vocabulary.meaning: Ten million. India's word for the 8th room from the right.
India groups digits as lakh/crore; most of the world groups as thousand/million/billion — same number, two naming systems.

story.title: The Charity Fund Crosses a Crore
story.text: The school's charity fund started the year at 85,00,000. After the fair, the principal announces on stage: 'We've crossed ONE CRORE!' Ananya does the maths: 85,00,000 + 15,00,000 = 1,00,00,000 — a whole crore! 'Every extra lakh took us closer,' she grins, 'and now we've joined the crore club.'
story.extractedProblem: The fund had 85,00,000. It grew by 15,00,000. What is the new total?

visual.caption: 3,25,00,000 = 3 crore + 25 lakh. Every bead-row is one more place, now stretching all the way to Crores.

teachingGallery.title: Crossing into crores — group with commas all the way
teachingGallery.note: The comma pattern never changes: 3 digits first, then every 2. Crore is just one more 2-digit group.

examples.caption: Each place is 10× the one before, all the way to crore: 1, 10, 100, 1,000, 10,000, 1,00,000, 10,00,000, 1,00,00,000.
Beads by place, now reaching all the way to Crores.
Every place from Ones to Crore, lit up together.

standardMethod.summary: Comma the number Indian-style all the way to crore, then read block by block from the left.
steps: From the RIGHT: comma after 3 digits, then every 2 — this now includes one extra pair for crore. 123456789 → 12,34,56,789.
Name the blocks: [12] crore, [34] lakh, [56] thousand, [789] the rest.
Read: 'twelve crore thirty-four lakh fifty-six thousand seven hundred eighty-nine'.
Digit value = digit × its room — same rule as every place before it.

alternateMethods.name: Expanded form
alternateMethods.whenToUse: To see every digit's true worth in a crore-scale number.
steps: Stretch the number room by room, now including crore.

alternateMethods.name: Indian vs International names
alternateMethods.whenToUse: When a news report says 'million' or 'billion' instead of lakh/crore.
steps: Convert by matching the zero-count, not the word.
3 crore 25 lakh — the rest are all zeros.

workedExamples.problem: Compare 95,00,000 and 1,00,00,000 — which is bigger and why?
steps: More digits (in the same comma style) always wins.
1,00,00,000 is bigger — a crore always beats any number of lakhs alone.

trickPractice.trick: Group in pairs after the first three
trickPractice.intro: From the right: 3 digits, then 2, 2, 2… crore just means one more pair joined the party.

questions.q: In 4,56,78,901 what is the VALUE of the digit 6?
hintLadder: The 6 sits in the LAKH place (the second digit of the lakh pair).

questions.q: In 7,23,45,610 what is the VALUE of the digit 7?
hintLadder: The 7 sits in the CRORE place — the very first group.

questions.q: In 1,08,90,234 what is the VALUE of the digit 8?
hintLadder: The 8 sits in the LAKH place (the second digit of the lakh pair).

questions.q: In 6,30,12,045 what is the VALUE of the digit 3?
hintLadder: The 3 sits in the TEN-LAKH place (the first digit of the lakh pair).

commonMistakes.mistake: Placing commas every 3 digits Western-style even past the lakh group (123,456,789).
commonMistakes.fix: Indian style never changes: 3 digits first, then every 2 — even for crores: 12,34,56,789.
1 crore = 1,00,00,000 = 10 million, not 1 million. A crore is TEN times a million.

commonMistakes.mistake: Comparing big crore-scale numbers by the first digit instead of the number of digits.
commonMistakes.fix: Count digits first: an 8-digit number always beats a 7-digit number, whatever the first digits look like.

easy.q: What is the VALUE of the digit 3 in 3,45,00,000? (Type like 30000000)
hintLadder: Which room does the 3 stand in? Count from the right.

easy.q: How many zeros are in one crore (1,00,00,000)?

hintLadder: More digits always wins — 1,00,00,000 is bigger.

medium.q: What is the VALUE of the digit 7 in 6,72,04,500? (Type like 7000000)
hintLadder: The 7 is the first digit of the '72' pair — the ten-lakh place.
Fill each room with its part.

challenge.q: A charity fund had ₹85,00,00,000 (85 crore). A donation drive added ₹15,00,00,000 (15 crore). What is the new total, in crores? (Type just the number, e.g. 40)
hintLadder: Add the crore-counts directly, just like adding ones.

questions.q: Value of the digit 9 in 9,45,12,000? (Type like 90000000)
hintLadder: Which room, counting from the right?
Count the zeros in a crore.
One crore beats every 7-digit number — even all-nines!

teachBackPrompt: Find a crore-scale number in the news — a movie's box office, a city's population, or a company's revenue. Write it with Indian commas, read it aloud for someone at home, and explain what its two biggest digits are worth.

revisionCard.summary: Rooms keep growing left: ...ten-thousands → lakhs → CROREs (1,00,00,000). Indian commas never stop: 3 digits, then 2-2-2 forever (12,34,56,789 = crore | lakh | thousand | rest). Comparing: count digits FIRST, same rule at any scale.

gameMission.title: The Crore Club Countdown
gameMission.brief: Help the charity fund's tote board climb from lakhs into crores — group each new total with Indian commas and announce it to the crowd before the 100-crore finale!

realLifeProject: Crore hunt: find one real crore-scale number in the news this week (a movie's box office, a company's revenue, a city's population). Write it with Indian commas and explain the value of its two biggest digits.

meta.curriculum: CBSE/NCERT Class 6 (Knowing Our Numbers — Indian numbering to crores)

rememberIt.hook: Crore = 1,00,00,000 = ten million — one wing further than lakh
rememberIt.unpack: Indian commas never stop: 3 then 2-2-2 forever. 12,34,56,789 reads crore | lakh | thousand | rest, same as every smaller number you've grouped before.

studentQuestions.q: Is a crore bigger than a million?
studentQuestions.a: Yes — 1 crore = 1,00,00,000 = 10 million. A crore is TEN times a million.
Ten crore (10,00,00,000), then arab (100 crore) — but crore is the one you'll meet most in everyday Indian numbers.
